{{Quote|Sir, I noticed earlier the hyperdrive motivator has been damaged. It's impossible to go to lightspeed!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''hyperdrive motivator''', also known as the '''Hyperdrive Control Unit''', was the primary [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] thrust initiator in any [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engine system.<ref name="SWS" /> It was connected to a vessel's main [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system to monitor and collect [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and navigation data in order to determine jump thrusts, adjust engine performance in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and calibrate safe returns to [[Realspace/Legends|normal space]]. It was [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] in a superconducting type of shield.<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

[[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] utilized four [[GBk-585 hyperdrive unit]]s, one located in each engine. The motivators were wired together with dual shielded circuit and were synched to fire simultaneously.<ref name="SWS" />

Components of the motivator included a [[sensor package]] and a [[power breaker]].

Failure of some components like the above, might result to false propulsion readings; in turn that would result to fatal miscalculations of hyperspace jumps as they took into account the ship's speed.<ref name="DF">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>
